title: Omarchy Plugin Manager
historySearch: Search backups by name or ID
historyHelp: Uninstalled plugins are kept locally. Restore reinstalls them disabled. Permanently deleted backups cannot be recovered.
historyEmpty: No uninstalled plugins are backed up.
historyLinked: Linked install: only the link is backed up; external files stay in place.
historyMissing: No backup files. The operation may have stopped before moving them.
historyConflict: Already installed. Restore will not overwrite the installed plugin.
historyDone_uninstall: Plugins uninstalled. Their local backups are in Uninstall history.
historyDone_restore: Plugin restored and left disabled. Enable it from Installed when ready.
historyRestored: %1 was restored and is installed but disabled.
confirmDeleteBackup: Permanently delete the backup of %1 (%2), removed %3, backup %4? This cannot be undone. An installed copy is not affected.
noHiddenSelection: No selected plugins are hidden by the current filters.
noInstalled: No plugins are available in this list. Check Hide native plugins in settings.
protectedSelf: Manager: cannot change or uninstall itself.
protectedNativeToggle: Native plugin: cannot uninstall or change its state.
protectedBarToggle: Full bar: cannot uninstall or change its state here.
protectedToggle: Omarchy does not allow enabling or disabling this plugin.
actionPartial: Completed: %1. Failed: %2. Not attempted: %3. Error: %4. Refresh and retry remaining items.
cleanupPartial: Deleted backups: %1. %2 Review Uninstall history and retry cleanup.
uninstallPartial: Backed up: %1. Failed: %2. Not attempted: %3. Error: %4. Review Uninstall history and retry remaining items.
search: Filter by name or ID; press Enter to add a chip
noDisabled: No disabled plugins match this filter.
positionHelp: Center joins the centered group and can shift the clock. Center begin and Center end sit beside that group. Tray places the widget in the tray drawer.
hideNativeHelp: Hide native rows and exclude them from list counts and selection.
showBarCountHelp: On horizontal bars. Counts follow the color rule; always-white counts all disabled plugins.
confirmRetention: Apply automatic deletion after %1 days? Existing expired backups may be permanently deleted immediately. This is separate from Delete all backups.
retentionHelp: Automatic deletion is permanent and can start immediately. Checked when the manager opens and hourly while the shell runs.
confirmDeleteAll: Permanently delete ALL local backups and history entries? This cannot be undone. Installed plugins are not affected.
skipUninstallConfirmHelp: Uninstall immediately when clicked. Backups are still kept; manual backup deletion always asks.
versionInfo: Plugin %1 · Omarchy %2. Reports open on GitHub with these versions filled in.

confirmRemove.one: Uninstall %1 user plugin and keep a local backup? Restore it disabled from Uninstall history. Linked installs retain the link, not a copy of external files.
confirmRemove.other: Uninstall %1 user plugins and keep local backups? Restore them disabled from Uninstall history. Linked installs retain the link, not copies of external files.

noActions: No selected plugins can use that action.
loadFailed: Could not load the plugin list.
invalidList: The plugin list returned invalid data.
positionFailed: Could not read this widget's bar position.
moveDone: Moved this widget to the %1 section.
